propositions: The session-start readiness gate waited for Epic Link and Epic Name fields that only provision when the first Jira Software project is created, causing an ordering deadlock independent of any budget timeout.

Experiment 30981084637 proved the deadlock: the fields remained absent after 180 seconds of idle time but appeared within 0.0512 seconds after project creation, proving time alone cannot satisfy the capability.

The incorrect decision rule in not_ready_message ('zero customfield_* entries mean the plugin is still starting') was self-confirming and misdiagnosed multiple failures by pointing readers at the budget when the real defect was ordering.

The fix relocates the Epic-field check from session-start wait_for_jira_dc_ready to post-creation _assert_project_capabilities where the fields can actually exist, and reduces the budget from 600s to 120s based on measured 0.0512s provisioning time.
The probe workflow in scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py had the same ordering bug: it called _await_named_fields before creating a project, and must reorder to await after project creation.
Live verification run 30982731669 achieved 62 passed and 1 xfailed with 0 failed and 0 errored cells, restoring parity with the last-known-green run 30964805133.
